title: Morning robin
story: A robin starts low, peeks over the hedge, and sings its way home.
childCue: Play G, A, B, G, B, A, G.
adultCue: This original tune changes direction twice. Break it after the first four notes if the full pattern feels crowded.
successCue: The morning robin sang with you!
tips: Look ahead to the next note.
Play slowly enough to keep fingers soft.
